title: trqp: run the end-to-end test against verify-trust v0.33.0
description: The bridge now speaks registry/authorization/0.2 only (PR trqp-0.2). tests/trqp/test_verify_trust.py targets verify-trust v0.33.0 and expects FIDO and P-256 signers trusted, RSA refused; it has not been run, because building verify-trust (about 1,100 crates' build scripts) needs Mark's go-ahead. Build: git checkout v0.33.0 in OpenVTC/verifiable-git-infrastructure; cargo build --locked --release -p verify-trust; VERIFY_TRUST=... pytest tests/trqp.
